name: pi-paper-desktop
description: Electron host for the Pi-Paper local desktop app

scripts.dist: npm run build:package && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --publish never && npm run checksums
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:package && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win --x64 --publish never && npm run checksums
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:package && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --mac --x64 --arm64 --publish never && npm run checksums
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:package && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --linux --x64 --publish never && npm run checksums
scripts.test:agent-runtime: npm run build:agent && npm run smoke:agent
